basics.name: Filippo Sallemi
basics.label: AI Solution Architect · iGaming & Affiliates
basics.summary: AI Solution Architect with 15+ years across iGaming and Affiliates, currently driving the agentic transformation of a NASDAQ-listed iGaming group. Hands-on practitioner of the modern AI stack — Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, custom MCP servers, agent skills, prompt engineering, and autonomous multi-agent systems — translated into production platforms that give every engineer governed access to AI. Proven across cloud cost optimization (19% AWS reduction), CI/CD acceleration (days → hours via Fargate/ECS), zero-downtime legacy rebuilds, and scaling engineering orgs from startup to 10+. Certified Scrum Master with a founder's mindset and a deep technical bench across PHP/Laravel, Go, Python, and AWS.

highlights: AI Strategy & Governance: Appointed to an elite leadership task force driving the company's transition toward an Agentic-Centric organizational structure.
Enterprise AI Knowledge Platform: Built a centralized, AI-queryable knowledge layer that unifies organizational memory across teams — eliminating context loss and accelerating decision-making.

Agentic AI Workspace: Delivered a secure, SSO-gated AI runtime giving every engineer governed access to autonomous agents — natively wired to the knowledge platform so every agent operates with full organizational context.
19% infrastructure cost reduction through strategic FinOps and cloud workload optimization in the first year.
Delivery Acceleration: Reduced environment provisioning from days to hours by architecting automated pipelines using AWS Fargate/ECS.
Established org-wide architectural standards, IaC (Terraform) adoption, and CI/CD best practices across all engineering teams.
AI Evangelism: Delivered internal technical talks on AI and MCP servers, training engineering teams across the organization on agentic patterns and tooling.
Built and managed a cross-functional team of 6 (devs + QA); defined quarterly OKRs and delivery roadmaps aligned with business goals.
Platform Modernisation: Led the full upgrade of the company's core software, reducing codebase by 2/3 — delivered on schedule with zero downtime.
Drove cross-team technical solutions and collaborated with DevOps on performance tuning and infrastructure improvements.

Resolved a critical technical impasse that had stalled ADM/AAMS certification for nearly a year, securing the Italian license within 3 months through a ruthless audit and refactoring of compliance protocols.
Optimised high-volume transactional backend in PHP/Laravel handling massive real-time gaming traffic with focus on data integrity and security.
Scaled engineering org from early-stage to 10+ members; reported to CTO; co-defined technical roadmap and organizational structure.
Casino Aggregator from zero: Integrated 40+ third-party game providers with sub-second latency and high availability under massive transactional load.

Spearheaded the successful migration of a legacy 'spaghetti-code' platform into a modern, scalable architecture within a few months. Managed the full transition of technical debt into a high-performance system while maintaining service continuity.
Managed multi-jurisdiction compliance (MGA, UKGC, Italy, Colombia) — 100% regulatory alignment across all markets.
Founded and ran a technology company for 7 years — full P&L ownership, client acquisition, and end-to-end technical delivery for government and private-sector clients.
Delivered Laravel web platforms, Linux infrastructure, network security systems, and embedded automation projects (maritime/yachts).
Led a team of 6 developers building the web UI for a VoIP/PBX product; worked extensively with Asterisk, SIP protocol and advanced networking.

projects.name: AI-Enhanced iGaming Aggregator
projects.description: Designed and built a full casino aggregator using a microservices architecture, complete with a back-office platform enriched with AI capabilities. Integrated a custom MCP server to connect the aggregator's data layer to LLMs — enabling natural-language querying of GGR reports, automated risk management, and autonomous business intelligence without manual SQL overhead.

projects.name: Crypto Payment Gateway
projects.description: Built a self-hosted Monero payment infrastructure using a local full node — implemented subaddress-based wallet management for per-transaction isolation, real-time payment verification via Monero RPC, and full transaction lifecycle handling with no third-party payment provider.
